notes: DATAMART CANNOT KEY THIS ENDPOINT (measured 2026-09-29): the ERP key is (baccount.number, locationId) = a business-account NUMBER and a location CODE ('HOVED', 'HS', 'MAIN', ... 116 codes). DataMart's Location has only internal integers (locationId, bAccountId; all 20,290 rows are ints and none equals an ERP code), and the location code exists nowhere in DataMart, so no join can recover it. normalize_location therefore leaves locationId null and keeps the internal numbers as locationInternalId / bAccountInternalId. Keep this endpoint ERP-sourced (ready=false). DataMart also lists 20,290 locations against 14,552 from the ERP. Removed 2026-09-30: the duplicate config `customer_locations`, which read the same URL (/v1/location) and returned identical rows (14,552 of 14,552, 0 differing). Supplier locations are the separate `supplier_locations` endpoint. Do not require `locationName`: 2 of 14,552 locations (e.g. locationId FEIL) have none, and one rejected row fails the whole endpoint run.
